findings.reason: the section should extend the owning gate (add the 1000-cell row and the 50 MB ceiling) rather than re-create the gate and the loop conversions.
findings.text: §2's done-when ("An executable-size gate sits beside the memory gate"; "trips and Newton steps run as lax.scan or while_loop"; "the read is evaluated once per trip") names a gate and two mechanisms that already exist: `evaluate_gate` / `MAX_300_EXECUTABLE_BYTES` in this file (with `tests/test_solve_program_size_gate.py`), `tests/test_solve_trips_are_a_scan.py` and `tests/test_one_read_per_trip.py`; implementing §2 as written duplicates committed surface

findings.reason: the section must state in its own text what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be.
